definitions.explanation: An oval reproductive body produced by birds.
Someone who is not yet fully developed.

examples.japanese: {卵焼|たまごや}きを{作|つく}る。

notes:
{卵|たまご} means egg.

ALTERNATE WRITING:
Also written as {玉子|たまご}, especially for chicken eggs used in cooking.

COMMON PREPARATIONS:
- {目玉焼|めだまや}き: fried egg
- {卵焼|たまごや}き: Japanese omelet
- {ゆで{卵|たまご}}: boiled egg
- {生|なま}{卵|たまご}: raw egg
